summary:
Status: complete — with one surprise: the 5 fixes were already on disk.

What I found: the worktree (`~/.hoocode/worktrees/noteapp/trim-tables`, branch `agent/trim-tables`) already contains both rewrites as uncommitted unstaged edits — the staged layer is the cut (deletions), the unstaged layer includes exactly the two fixes this slice describes (verified via `git diff` of each hunk against the brief: text-based CSV loop with `vault::stem` block path + `pane().editor` assertions in `save_close.rs`; `Data.csv` entry + sheet `else`-branch removed and test renamed in `sharing.rs`). Per the "do not redo the cut / edit ONLY those two files" constraints, I made zero edits and spent the slice on the prescribed verification instead.

Files changed by me: none. Uncommitted state left as-is: `M src/shell/tests/save_close.rs`, `M src/shell/tests/sharing.rs` (plus the prior worker's staged cut + other unstaged adjustments — untouched).

Verification output:
- `rustfmt --edition 2021 --check` (parse check): `save_close.rs` passes fully clean. `sharing.rs` parses OK with two diffs — one at line 74 (`copie.pdf` assert) proven pre-existing by running the same check on `git show HEAD:...` output (base fails identically; toolchain drift, so CI cannot be gating on fmt), one cosmetic array-collapse in the edited region. Left both untouched per minimal-change.
- `grep`: no `Data.csv`/sheet-branch symbols in either file (only the `"close-sheets"` test slug and lowercase `data.csv`/`data.tsv` text fixtures, which are correct post-cut). No `shown_sheet`/`undo_len`/`set_view`/`is_dirty`/`.sheet()` refs in either file, no refs to the old test name, and no `shown_sheet` anywhere in `src/`. Remaining `table`/`in_table` hits are GFM Markdown helpers explicitly kept per the brief.
- Careful re-read for type-correctness: `vault::stem` exists (`src/platform/vault.rs:217`, returns `String`) and `vault::` is in scope via `super::*` (precedent: `panel.rs:99`, `panes.rs:242`, `vault_views.rs:380`); `&String`→`&str` deref matches `told(tone, part: &str)` (`toasts.rs:92`, `contains`-based) with precedent in `sharing.rs`; the block-dir formula `path.with_file_name(format!(".{}.tmp", stem))` matches `vault::write` exactly (`vault.rs:1215`); the failure toast embeds `vault::stem` of the pane path (`notes.rs:565-590`), so the `told` assertion will match at runtime; `pane().path/dirty/editor` usage mirrors neighboring tests in the same file; the `sharing.rs` loop entries (Drawing.svg, Foreign.svg, Picture.png) exactly match the remaining if/else-if branches with no dangling `else`.

What remains (for a follow-up slice): nothing in this slice's scope — both files are done. CI must run the test suite to prove compile + behavior (no build/test run here, per the explicit ban — compile is unverified).

Confirmation: no `cargo build`/`check`/`test` was run; no commits, no pushes, no branch switches, no parent-tree writes.

Open questions: (1) Want a follow-up to apply the one-line cosmetic rustfmt collapse in `sharing.rs:161`, or leave it since base isn't fmt-clean under this toolchain? (2) The staged cut + unstaged test fixes are both uncommitted — owner should decide when to commit; I left everything untouched.
